answer: Anchor each identity to a single privacy-preserving biometric hash: a salted hash of a liveness-checked scan, so one living person maps to exactly one identity and a farm of clones collapses onto the same hash like filings to a jade magnet. The failure mode is a stolen template replayed without a live body, so bind every hash to a fresh liveness challenge each epoch that a replay cannot forge. The check: before any capability is granted, the registry confirms the hash is unseen and the liveness proof is fresh, then lets reputation grow plume by plume through honest work.
